title: The main thing is that you end up knowing many things that we did not know.
text: The experience was good, the guy, Alex, was very nice and kind and the explanations were very good.
author: fidelangelg2026

title: Grenada February 2022
text: Magnificent tour of Nasrid Granada, walking through the hand of Caesar, buildings and natural environments that immediately transfer to a reference period to understand the Muslim world. Magnificent explanations and great sensations. We'll repeat.
author: Antonio_1248

title: Unforgettable walk through the centre of Granada
text:
We have made the guided tour "Secrets of the center" by the hand of the great guide Alejandro. 

All the members of the group know Granada but, thanks to Alejandro and his enthusiasm and passion when it comes to telling the stories, we were able to rediscover our city with new eyes. 

We have expanded our knowledge of Granada’s history, which is inexhaustible, and we have had fun with the stories and curiosities of the most central corners of the Alhambra city. 

Undoubtedly, walking the streets knowing the mysteries that hide their buildings and monuments, will be a much more enriching activi
author: I7036GCjosem

title: Surprising
text:
We made secret Grenada. 
Everything in general we liked. 
Guide Alejandro García made it enjoyable and fun, with projector included of some stories.
Very well explained and recommended.
Keep in mind that it lasts 2 hours and a half, so it is better to go to dinner because then everything is closed.
author: Vueltus555

title: Wonderful experience with Alejandro
text: We made two visits one night to the Nasrid palaces and Charles V and another in the morning to the alcazaba and the generalife. Alejandro our guide who is passionate about Granada made us love her and wish to come back as soon as we can and rehire more visits.
author: 191margah

title: FANTASTIC
text: It was all...guide...people...the moon...plus the guide would bring us into conversation with questions about the subject.
author: TOIREG

title: Magic
text: It was a wonderful experience. The Alhambra is always fascinating but even more so at night. Alejandro, the guide, introduced us with his explanations and pleasantness in a magical world. I learned through him information unknown to many about the history of the Grenadians of the time.
author: mari angeles g

title: Thank you Alejandro
text: Afternoon. The story of the Alhambra can be told in different ways, our guide Alejandro was able to convey his passion. Of course I recommend 100% your hiring. Greetings.
author: crisfernan

title: Excellent, fun and amazing
text: Lorena explained everything with a passion that transmits you to the life of the time. We really enjoyed the route. The houses we saw inside are beautiful. You don't expect there to be anything like that behind a wall... Highly recommended this route.
author: Congonza13

title: Magnificent visit to the Moorish houses.
text:
Guided tour by Alex, very professional, led with commitment and charm.
We have had an enriching experience about the details of Nasrid life.
Recommended without a doubt.
